Title: LinkedIn Learning and Workera Deep Integration Guide

Blocks.Text:
Content Discovery: Automated Catalog Sync (English)
Reporting: N/A

Requirements:
The LinkedIn Learning and Workera integration involves the following requirements:

An active Workera instance
An active LinkedIn Learning account
Admin access to LinkedIn Learning
Admin privileges to your Workera LMS instance

During the initial configuration, you can configure LinkedIn Learning and Workera to establish a secure SAML Single Sign-on (SSO) connection to ensure seamless access to content. SSO authentication reduces friction for users and administrators by eliminating the need for manual user registration. SSO ensures learners spend more of their time watching content and less of their time trying to remember usernames and passwords.
The LinkedIn Learning library contains over 24,000 courses, with 20-30 courses added per week at no extra cost.

Workera automates this process using the LinkedIn Learning content APIs, so LMS admins do not have to manually upload new content packages at regular intervals. After the initial setup, Workera will dynamically refresh the content library on an automated basis. This ensures new LinkedIn Learning content is available to learners within 24 hours of release. All content titles and descriptions are aggregated and indexed to accommodate keyword searches and support efficient discoverability.
Workera supports automatic syncing of English content libraries.
Enabling SAML SSO:

LinkedIn Learning recommends SAML SSO for all enterprise learning platform integrations. SSO authentication can be configured in your LinkedIn Learning Admin settings. Most organizations have a centrally managed identity management solution like Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), Okta or ADFS which can be configured to authenticate users into enterprise applications like LinkedIn Learning.

To configure SAML SSO with your identity management solution, share the LinkedIn Learning SSO Implementation Guide with your organization’s IT team.

Blocks.Text: To sync your Workera content with LinkedIn Learning, take the following steps:

Blocks.Section: Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
SectionPath: LMS Configuration – Steps Performed in LinkedIn Learning
Provision LinkedIn Learning Content API Keys
Blocks.Text:
Login to LinkedIn Learning. If you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin, then click Me > Integrate





From the side navigation menu, Access content and reports via API.

Click the down arrow on the right to expand the Generate LinkedIn Learning REST API Application section.





Click Add Application and provide the name related to your LMS (e.g., "Workera LMS Integration"), as the application name, and provide a short description of the integration use case in the application description field. For example, "Workera content catalog sync".





Under choose keys, there are two checkboxes – Content and Report. Select Content only.

Click Next and accept the Terms and Conditions.

Save the Client ID and Client Secret values.
